entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `dotnetup` should support non-native architecture installs #55083
  • Enable NAOT command handling by default #55078
    11.0.1xx
  • Add a linux NAOT build leg #55077
    11.0.1xx

    11.0.1xx
  • The new dotnetup setup leads to missing .net 5 runtime in vscode warning #55071

Closed

  • TemplateEngineToolDiscovery Network Failure: Unable to read data from the transport connection: Connection reset by peer #51154

    10.0.1xx

  • `dotnet run --help` does not show `--environment` switch #35108

  • `dotnet help` dumps stack in GitHub Codespaces #35248
  • Is it possible to use the SDK inside and Xamarin/MAUI app? #35419
  • Linux issue [libhostpolicy.so] #35410

  • `dotnet add --file apphost.cs reference Awesome.Project.csproj` is not supported yet #52423
  • Require `#!` for more file-based app scenarios #53749
  • File-based apps don't re-evaluate during `--no-build` unlike project-based apps #54551
  • ItShouldDetectFileWithMarkOfTheWeb: Expected boolean to be True, but found False #54928
  • `dotnet publish` breaking change between 10.0.101 and 10.0.2xx/10.0.3xx: `Program does not contain a static 'Main' method` #54841
